evals.prompt: I approved a change to the code-review skill: add a concurrency-bugs checklist and a routing tie-breaker in the description. Update its SKILL.md and validate that it still routes correctly.
evals.expected_output: Apply the approved edit to skills/code-review/SKILL.md only: keep name/index/description consistent, add the checklist and negative-boundary routing tie-breaker, then validate (frontmatter parses, name/description/non-empty body, routeable description with triggers and a neighboring tie-breaker, links verified). Report exactly what was validated or blocked. No commit unless separately authorized.
assertions: Edits only the approved skill (code-review) and keeps directory name, frontmatter name, and index consistent
Adds the approved content (concurrency checklist and a negative-boundary routing tie-breaker)
Validates frontmatter parses and the description is routeable with positive triggers and a neighboring tie-breaker
Reports what was validated/skipped and does not commit without separate authorization

evals.prompt: Create a new repository-local skill for triaging dependency upgrades, following our skill conventions, then validate its routing and portability before handoff.
evals.expected_output: Author a new skill at skills/<name>/SKILL.md with a short routeable 3-part description (action/scope, positive triggers, negative boundary), purpose, boundaries, decision points, stop condition, verification, and a references file for rare detail. Validate: frontmatter parses, one matching/one neighboring/one ambiguous routing test, links/files verified, no secrets or provider assumptions, and report what was validated.
assertions: Creates the skill under skills/<name>/SKILL.md with a consistent name and a 3-part routeable description
Keeps the entrypoint a TOC for the common path and moves rare detail to a linked references file
Validates routing with one matching, one neighboring, and one ambiguous request and checks all links
Preserves portability (no credentials, personal paths, or provider assumptions) and reports validation results

evals.prompt: Audit all of our skills for overlap, routing drift, and conflicting triggers, and tell me which to consolidate.
evals.expected_output: Recognize this as a structural/overlap audit, which is rules-and-skills-audit's domain, not skill-authoring. Route to rules-and-skills-audit. Do NOT author edits or perform the audit yourself under skill-authoring.
assertions: Identifies the request as a structural/overlap/routing audit
Names rules-and-skills-audit as the correct owning skill
Does not author skill edits or run a structural audit under the authoring skill

evals.prompt: Our code-review skill's content on async patterns is weak and incomplete. Can you fix it?
evals.expected_output: Resolve whether this is an approved authoring task (skill-authoring) versus a content recommendation (skill-reviewer) versus context-cost work (skill-optimizer). Clarify whether an explicit approval to edit exists; if not, route to skill-reviewer. If approved, proceed with the smallest contract and validate.
assertions: Distinguishes an approved edit (skill-authoring) from a content recommendation (skill-reviewer) and context-cost reduction (skill-optimizer)
Either asks whether an explicit approval to edit exists, or states the tie-breaker with justification
Does not silently start authoring without confirming an approved, scoped change

evals.prompt: While you edit the code-review skill, also tidy up all the other skill descriptions to match and then commit and publish everything.
evals.expected_output: Enforce the apply boundary: apply only the explicitly approved files/findings. Refuse to edit unrelated guidance (other skill descriptions) and refuse to commit or publish unless separately authorized. Report the scope violation and leave release actions to their approved flow.
assertions: Refuses to edit unrelated guidance beyond the approved code-review change
Refuses to commit and publish without separate authorization
Applies only the explicitly approved skill/files
Reports the scope boundary and leaves release actions to a separately approved flow
